capabilities: Open, hide, restart, or quit Obsidian from the tray menu
Create a quick note from the tray or a global shortcut
Open Obsidian Search or Quick Switcher from the tray or a global shortcut
extras: Designed for Windows desktop environments; global shortcuts may fail due to Electron or Windows restrictions.
problem: Users need a way to keep Obsidian running and accessible from the system tray while performing quick actions like note creation or searching.
summary: A system tray utility that allows Obsidian to run minimized in the Windows tray and provides quick access to notes and search functions.
